name: hud_ui_mgr_objective_tick_meter_fill_animation
description: HudUiMgrObjective::TickMeterFillAnimation advances the objective meter fill timer, updates the top fill edge, and disables the animation when the fill completes.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL at 0x4117f0 show unscaled delta accumulation, a 3.0 second completion threshold, ceil(fillPixelsMax) and animation-disable on completion, ceil(timer * 0.333332986 * fillPixelsMax) while in progress, integer conversion of point[1].y, and writes to meter points 0 and 3.
The native HUD objective smoke verifies the in-progress fill calculation and the completion path that clamps to the full meter height and clears objectiveMeterFillAnimEnabled.
